text_block_list.text:
As Симболи Рудольф helps the students
ease into
the new year, she receives the
news that Air
Groove has collapsed.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The reason turns out to be from
overwork, and
Rudolf blames herself for
letting Эйр Грув's
schedule get so out
of hand.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Эйр Грув snaps back, saying that
Rudolf
doesn't understand at all—words
that seem to
strike home.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
